answer: An admission auction stops fake identities at the harbor gate: only 50 slots open per epoch, and applicants bid a deposit, the top 50 admitted and losers refunded. The deposit thaws at a glacier pace over 20 epochs, so one fund cannot be recycled through many accounts in a spiral of re-entry. Making 100 fakes costs 100 wins at 200 credits each, 20,000 credits locked, while an honest agent pays once, recovers its bid, and earns undiluted rewards.
